summary: Issue #173: lightweight MYTHOS AUTO WhatsApp auto-reply engine built on #172's comms layer and the existing Evolution gateway (separate customer instance per project, mythos-bridge reserved), no Chatwoot, no second gateway. Deterministic intents, unconnected business-data port (factual questions -> human handoff), template-first generation with opt-in AI behind a fact guard, idempotency/loop-safety ledger, explicit outbound policy gate, loopback-only receiver (not deployed), simulate/classify/readiness CLI. Everything off by default; bridge/notify untouched; host re-verified; no customer message sent. Committed 13dbec2 on mythos/gh/gh-issue-173 (not pushed, not merged). AI_HANDOVER, CHANGELOG and architecture doc updated.
